currentParagraphText: “As I said... Minaga is Minaga,” Miyamoto said, having chosen long ago not to overthink the Unique Lifeform. Sure, logically, he knew the elf was entirely correct, but sometimes it was best just to follow Jake’s creed of not overcomplicating things.
